B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 4 to 6)
LONG JUMP (20 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this part.
This task is about modelling long jumping.
Athletes run along a track and then jump as far as they can in one leap.
The horizontal distance jumped is called their long jump distance.
Run-up Take-off Flight through the air Landing
At take-off, athletes jump up giving them a vertical speed.
Their horizontal speed carries them forward in their flight through the air.
The vertical speed and the horizontal speed give the take-off speed.
